title: Talking Past the Machine: Morality, Politeness, and Alignment in Human-AI Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2609.21401v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational AI systems produce fluent, socially appropriate responses, yet whether they participate in cooperative communication or merely simulate its surface forms remains unclear - a question central to how these systems are evaluated, trusted, and designed. This study investigates how morality, politeness, and alignment - three dimensions central to cooperative dialogue - function in human-AI interaction compared to human-human conversation. We analyze 15,881 human-ChatGPT and 10,784 human-human multi-turn dialogues, using mixed-effects models to identify which features predict turn-to-turn alignment. We observe a consistent dissociation: AI produces the surface features of cooperative communication without the underlying social architecture. translated_title: 与机器各说各话：人机对话中的道德、礼貌与对齐
translated_abstract: 会话式AI系统能够产生流畅且符合社交规范的回应，然而它们究竟是在真正参与合作性沟通，还是仅仅在模拟其表面形式，目前仍不清楚——这一问题对于这些系统如何被评估、信任和设计至关重要。本研究考察了道德、礼貌和对齐这三个合作性对话的核心维度，在人机交互中与人人对话相比是如何发挥作用的。我们分析了15,881条人类与ChatGPT的多轮对话以及10,784条人与人之间的多轮对话，使用混合效应模型识别哪些特征能够预测逐轮对齐。我们观察到一个一致的分离现象：AI产生了合作性沟通的表面特征，却缺乏其底层的社会架构。道德输出似乎是预先配置的而非协商达成的；温暖是在缺乏面子敏感性的情况下生成的；语言趋同持续下降。最引人注目的是，合作机制……
tldr: 该研究通过分析近2.7万条对话发现，AI虽能模仿合作性沟通的表面特征，却缺乏其底层社会架构——道德表达是预先配置而非协商达成的，温暖缺乏面子敏感性，语言趋同持续下降。
en_tdlr: Analyzing nearly 27,000 dialogues, this study finds that AI produces the surface features of cooperative communication without its underlying social architecture—moral output is preconfigured rather than negotiated, warmth lacks face sensitivity, and linguistic convergence persistently declines.
